sloka: वैदेही च अपि तत् सर्वम् न शुश्राव तपस्विनी ।तत् एव हृदि तस्याः च यौवराज्य अभिषेचनम् ॥२-२६-३॥
transliteration: vaidehī ca api tat sarvam na śuśrāva tapasvinī ।tat eva hṛdi tasyāḥ ca yauvarājya abhiṣecanam ॥2-26-3॥

translations.english: Sita, her mind preoccupied with thoughts about consecration, was engaged in religious austerities and hence could not hear of all this (development).
